summary: A refused `ingest plans` writes a file when the hot rung is sqlite: with `hot: {backend: sqlite, path: .canon/hot.db}` routed for task and an openspec `root:` one level too high, `canon ingest plans` exits 2 INGEST_SOURCE_INVALID and `.canon/hot.db` is created (observed at 26cb75b5). The preview pass `run_pass_for(.., dry_run=true, will_write=true)` calls open_store, which attaches the hot db. The brief says the five commands that cannot start write nothing, and the message says `nothing was persisted`. Judge the sources before open_store (the malformed check needs only the scan), or open the store read-only in the preview. atip.codeexit.08 uses a git-only tier, so it cannot see this.
